title: Review — Payments API v2

title: Glossary and ID Conventions
summary: ID formats used across the repo so agents can trace requirements, controls, patterns and guardrails.

title: Enterprise Security Principles
summary: Eight non-negotiable principles every design must demonstrably satisfy: zero trust, least privilege, secure by default, defence in depth, encrypt everywhere, observable by design, automate controls, explicit risk ownership.

title: Use service mesh mTLS for Kubernetes east-west traffic
summary: Mesh-issued SPIFFE identities with mTLS STRICT are the standard for in-cluster service-to-service auth; app-level JWT only as an addition.

title: Legacy settlement batch uses static key
summary: Time-bound waiver of SEC-IAM-001.R1 for the legacy settlement batch until migration to workload identity (expires 2027-03-31).

title: No long-lived IAM user access keys for workloads
summary: No long-lived IAM user access keys for workloads (enforces SEC-IAM-001.R1, preventive)

title: No wildcard action on wildcard resource
summary: No wildcard action on wildcard resource (enforces SEC-IAM-001.R3, preventive)

title: Prod admin roles only assumable via PAM broker
summary: Prod admin roles only assumable via PAM broker (enforces SEC-IAM-002.R3, preventive)

title: Load balancers/listeners enforce TLS 1.2+
summary: Load balancers/listeners enforce TLS 1.2+ (enforces SEC-DATA-001.R1, preventive)

title: Storage and databases encrypted at rest
summary: Storage and databases encrypted at rest (enforces SEC-DATA-001.R2, preventive)

title: Public endpoints must be associated with WAF
summary: Public endpoints must be associated with WAF (enforces SEC-NET-001.R1, detective)

title: No public IPs on compute/data services
summary: No public IPs on compute/data services (enforces SEC-NET-001.R2, preventive)

title: Account enrolled in org audit log sink
summary: Account enrolled in org audit log sink (enforces SEC-LOG-001.R1, detective)

title: No secrets in IaC or images
summary: No secrets in IaC or images (enforces SEC-SEC-001.R2, preventive)

title: Envelope Encryption with Enterprise KMS
summary: Per-application CMKs in enterprise KMS, key policy scoped to workload identity, automatic rotation, separation of key admins from key users.

title: OIDC Federation with Enterprise IdP
summary: Authorization Code + PKCE against the enterprise IdP; group-to-role mapping in IdP; tokens validated at gateway and service.

title: Service-to-Service Authentication
summary: Mesh mTLS (Kubernetes) or cloud-signed tokens (serverless) plus receiver-side authorisation policy.

title: SIEM Log Forwarding
summary: Org-level audit log sinks to central log archive account; application security events via OTel collector to SIEM in the enterprise schema.

title: Enterprise Edge (WAF + DDoS + API Gateway)
summary: Public DNS → CDN/DDoS → managed WAF (enterprise ruleset) → API gateway → private load balancer → workload.

title: Runtime Secrets Retrieval
summary: Workload identity fetches secrets at runtime (CSI driver on Kubernetes, SDK/extension on serverless); rotation via managed rotation functions.

title: AI / LLM System Security
summary: LLM/ML systems: approved model providers only, prompt-injection defences, tool/agent permissions least-privileged, and no restricted data to external models.

title: Encryption in Transit and at Rest
summary: TLS 1.2+ everywhere; all storage encrypted at rest; confidential+ uses enterprise CMKs.

title: Handling Restricted and Regulated Data (PII / PCI / PHI)
summary: Confidential+ data needs data-flow mapping, minimisation, tokenisation for PCI, field-level protection for restricted data and no sensitive data in logs.

title: Workload Identity and Service Authentication
summary: Workloads authenticate with platform-issued, short-lived identities (no static keys), are scoped per service, and authorise every call.

title: Human Access, SSO and Privileged Access
summary: All human access via enterprise IdP (OIDC/SAML) with phishing-resistant MFA; admin/production access via PAM with just-in-time elevation.

title: Security Logging and SIEM Integration
summary: Platform audit logs and application security events forwarded to SIEM in the standard schema, retained 1 year, with detections agreed with SecOps.

title: Internet-Facing Services
summary: Internet/partner-exposed endpoints sit behind the enterprise edge (WAF + DDoS + API gateway), never expose compute or data stores directly, and are rate-limited.

title: Secrets Management
summary: Secrets only in the enterprise secrets manager, fetched at runtime, rotated automatically; none in code, images or IaC state.

title: Enterprise Security Architecture Strategy 2026–2028
summary: Three-year direction: identity as the perimeter, controls-as-code aligned to the AaC programme, central SIEM/detection coverage, and secure AI adoption.

title: Security Capability Roadmap
summary: Machine-readable maturity/progression per strategic theme; agents use it to know which capabilities are available now vs planned.
